name: Wisconsin

default_limits.basis: Wis. Stat. 346.57(4): 25 in cities/villages (e), 35 outlying/semiurban (f)(g), 65 expressways (gm)1, 70 freeways (gm)2, 55 everywhere else (h), 15 alleys (d), 45 rustic roads (k)

fine.notes: Civil forfeiture $30-$300 (freeway/expressway $50-$300), plus fees. Deposit set by statewide schedule; per-mph brackets not verified.

court_costs.notes: Fixed $137.50 fees plus 26% penalty surcharge on the forfeiture. Milwaukee County +$3.50.

zones.work_zone: Forfeiture doubled if workers endangered; injury to a worker: up to $10,000 and 9 months jail
zones.school_zone: 15 mph passing a school when children present; forfeiture doubled when children present

court.reason: Mandatory 15-day license suspension for 25+ over a 55/65/70 statutory limit (not locally zoned limits)

arrest.offense: None by speed alone; speeding is a civil forfeiture
arrest.citation: Wis. Stat. 346.60 (forfeitures); reckless driving 346.62 has no speed threshold

sources.title: Trans 101 demerit points (archived admin code insert)
WI uniform deposit schedule 2026 (speed table not readable)

notes: The speeding table in the state deposit schedule could not be read, so per-mph deposit amounts are missing. WisDOT example: 11-15 over = $175.30 total. Some 346.57(4) limits apply only where signed. Truck limits not researched.
